property_summary: For any owner-invoked AdjustBetAmounts(amount), the contract's public currentBetLimit() equals the value emitted in the BetLimitChanged event; the mutant emits betLimit-1 so there exist amounts where the emitted value differs from the getter causing the property to fail.
change_summary: Change the emitted event argument so AdjustBetAmounts now emits an incorrect (old) betLimit value by emitting betLimit - 1 instead of betLimit, which can make the call succeed in both but observers see different emitted data (and in some tests a revert if underflow protections existed).
